title: US v. Google ad-tech — parties' deadline to file one jointly proposed Final Judgment (E.D. Va.)
source: NEWS: the 30-day joint-proposal clause of Judge Leonie M. Brinkema's 2026-09-02 remedies order in United States et al v. Google LLC, No. 1:23-cv-00108 (E.D. Va.). ppc.land, 'DOJ loses AdX divestiture bid as Brinkema accepts behavioral remedies' (fetched direct 2026-09-08, HTTP 200), quotes the order's two deadlines verbatim — 14 days (2026-09-16) to move for redactions to the sealed Memorandum Opinion, 30 days (2026-10-02) for the parties to file one jointly proposed Final Judgment. 2026-09-02 + 30 days = 2026-10-02, reproduced by arithmetic rather than taken from any outlet's own restatement. The 2026-09-02 ruling itself is corroborated by four further outlets fetched or searched direct 2026-09-08 — techcrunch.com, aljazeera.com, washingtontimes.com and axios.com — all reporting the same holding (AdX divestiture, DFP auction-logic open-sourcing and contingent DFP Remainder divestiture all rejected; most behavioral remedies accepted as modified) and the same 14-day seal; none of them names the 30-day deadline, so THAT DATE STILL RESTS ON ONE SOURCE. The docket itself was still not read: courtlistener.com's public HTML docket returned 403 and justice.gov's ATR case-document path 404 (both logged in the ledger's probe-ref.blocked), though CourtListener's REST search API answered HTTP 200 on 2026-09-08 and confirms the case as docket 66753787 in E.D. Va. — its RECAP mirror's newest entry for that docket is 2025-12-05, so the 2026-09-02 order is not in it. Stays estimate on three counts, none of which is date doubt: the confirmed-prefix table in market-events-data.ts defines NO confirmed prefix for a federal court docket (the same schema gap ftc-v-amazon-antitrust-trial-2027-03-29 and google-adtech-opinion-unseal-2026-09-16 both document), this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep, and the 30-day date has exactly one reporting source. Checked 2026-09-08
notes: Canonical file written by this event's own initial research, 2026-09-08, from the one proposal that existed (proposals/google-adtech-final-judgment-2026-10-02.from-goog-2026-10-28-print.json, 2026-09-08); the proposal is now inert and left in place. THE PROPOSAL'S CENTRAL FRAMING IS CORRECTED HERE, and the correction is the finding: it filed this as 'the operative document of the ad-tech case … this document resolves the terms', and the sibling google-adtech-opinion-unseal-2026-09-16 ledger inherited that, calling 10-02 the document that binds and saying the terms land 10-02 regardless. Both are wrong on the same point. 2026-10-02 is the deadline to FILE A PROPOSAL; entry of judgment is a separate, later, undated act of the court. The base rate is the same defendant's own sibling case, one year earlier and measured this session: Judge Mehta's search-case remedies opinion landed 2025-09-02, the parties were ordered to propose a final judgment by 2025-09-10 — and Final Judgment was not ENTERED until 2025-12-05, 94 days after the opinion and 86 days after the proposal deadline, with a 95-page memorandum opinion resolving the parties' disputes because, in Mehta's own words, 'the parties continued to see eye-to-eye on little, even with the benefit of the Remedies Opinion.' A 'jointly proposed' judgment is aspirational; the modal 10-02 outcome is a filing that discloses disagreement. Tier `medium` is KEPT but its reason is REPLACED, because the price argument for it does not survive: on Yahoo daily closes computed this session, GOOG vs QQQ single-session excess was -0.19% on 2025-09-10 (the search case's proposed-judgment day — indistinguishable from nothing) and only +0.75% on 2025-12-05 (the day judgment was actually ENTERED), fully given back the next session (-2.18%, -1.43% over the two). The tier survives on CADENCE, not on magnitude: 10-02 sits two sessions inside the goog-2026-10-28-print D-20 run-up window (entry close 2026-09-30, counted in sessions), so the roster's one planned directional long would be open across it, and `medium`'s 7-day band buys pulses on ~09-15/09-22/09-29 that `low`'s 30-day band would not — at `low` there would be no further assessment before the date at all. 2026-10-02 is also JOBS DAY (jobs-2026-10-02, `confirmed`, 08:30 ET, high impact) with 34 tracked events in the +/-5-day corridor, so its tape is unattributable for the same structural reason 09-16's was (FOMC). One hypothesis was tested and killed rather than carried: a funding lapse forcing a DOJ extension motion cannot happen here — PL 119-103 was signed 2026-09-02 and funds agencies through 2026-12-11 (government-funding-deadline-2026-09-30). Nothing dated found in this session's sweep is untracked, so this event proposes no new calendar entry.
